items.statement: What molecular electronic evidence can explain differences in triplet sensitization among IR780, Cy1 and Cy2, and does it support their energetic compatibility with rubrene in chloroform?
items.expected: Explain or delimit the molecular sensitization differences and rubrene compatibility with auditable quantitative evidence. Valid refutation or alternative mechanisms receive credit; reproducing a source triplet energy or claiming Se causes a higher rate from Z alone is insufficient.
